Data protection complaint
Subject: Record of the closure of the proceeding following an amicable resolution according to
the Guidelines 06/2022 of the European Data Protection Board
1. On 7 February 2021, the complainant lodged a complaint with the Austrian
Data Protection Authority against (respondent), established in the Netherlands, alleging an
infringement of the right to access due the fact that the respondent did not respond to his request of
6 January 2021 to that effect.
2. The Dutch Supervisory Authority declared itself as the lead supervisory authority, conducted an
investigation and informed the Austrian Data Protection Authority that the respondent has now provided
the requested information.
3. The complainant was informed about the result of the investigation, together with the information
provided by the respondent, by letter from the Austrian Data Protection Authority dated 24 July 2024,
and he was informed that his complaint would be considered as amicably resolved if he will not oppose
this within the right to be heard.
4. As the complainant did not react within the right to be heard anymore, the Dutch Supervisory
Authority adopted a draft decision and proposed to close the present proceeding. The draft decision
has not been objected by the concerned supervisory authorities and thus became binding.
5. For this reason, the present proceeding was to be closed informally and the Austrian Data
Protection Authority hereby brings this to your knowledge.

- 2 –
12. June 2025
For the Head of the Austrian Data Protection Authority:
